### Data Validation & Cleaning
```{python}
# Vera section




# Molly section

# grid construction reference: https://james-brennan.github.io/posts/fast_gridding_geopandas/

# total area for the grid
xmin = -115
ymin = 31
xmax = -109
ymax = 37

num_x = 15  # how many cells in x direction
num_y = 20  # how many cells in y direction
            # total cells is num_x*num_y (300 in our case)

cell_size_x = (xmax-xmin)/num_x
cell_size_y = (ymax-ymin)/num_y
# how many cells across and down
# projection of the grid
crs = "EPSG:4326"
# create the cells in a loop
grid_cells = []
for x0 in np.arange(xmin, xmax+cell_size_x, cell_size_x ):
    for y0 in np.arange(ymin, ymax+cell_size_y, cell_size_y):
        # bounds
        x1 = x0-cell_size_x
        y1 = y0+cell_size_y
        grid_cells.append( shapely.geometry.box(x0, y0, x1, y1)  )
cell = gpd.GeoDataFrame(grid_cells, columns=['geometry'], 
                                 crs=crs)


# plt.scatter([-130, -132, -128, -139],[42, 31, 32, 47])
# ax = plt.gca()
# plt.autoscale(False)
ax = cell.plot(facecolor="none")
# ax.axis("off")

df_2022 = pd.read_csv('data/Traffic/stations/df_2022')

df_2022['geometry'] = gpd.points_from_xy(df_2022.longitude, df_2022.latitude, crs="EPSG:4326")

gdf_2022 = gpd.GeoDataFrame(data=df_2022, geometry='geometry')

gdf_2022.plot(aspect=1,ax=ax, color='red')
plt.show()
# gdf_2022.plot(aspect=1)
gdf_2022_binned = gpd.sjoin(left_df=gdf_2022, right_df=cell, how='left')

gdf_2022_binned
```
